CI only, served only by the app built with the probe feature (src-tauri/src/probe.rs): loaded into the room window with SIDEVOICE_DEBUG=1 SIDEVOICE_DEBUG_PAGE=card-probe.html. It reports a call through the bridge, as the room does, and walks it through the states the call controls card shows (sidevoice/sidevoice-desktop#4), one phase at a time: the first long enough for CI to click, drag and type around the card, the others for a screenshot each. It is the room for the card's buttons too: it answers mute and hang-up as the room would, and says each command it gets.
